config.guidance: Ordinary substantive non-final assistant text stays inside the current activity group automatically. Only when you intentionally need a user-visible working update, call `publish_main_message` with the complete clean text to show as a normal standalone assistant bubble while the run continues. Do not use that call for the final response. The call never asks for approval or pauses the run; continue work normally after it. Do not emit visibility markers or other control text in assistant prose.
